senses.gloss: f., pl. סִתְוָונִיּוֹת, סִתְוָנִ׳, סִיתְ׳ (preced.) winter-fruits, late fruits (remaining on the tree until winter-time).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:2">Ter. XI, 2</cite> <he>חומץ ס׳</he> vinegar made of late grapes; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="O00785"><he>סִיפְוָונִיּוֹת</he></cite>.
